desc:
✨ Welcome to YOUTOPIA, a magical medieval kingdom! ✨

🔮 AWAKEN MAGIC – Visit Fern the Grand Wizard and roll for one of 20 magic elements, from Fire and Lightning to Cosmic and Time. Rare mutations can turn your book into a 1 in a BILLION legend!

🗺️ EXPLORE 9 BIOMES – Crystal Shores, Golden Fields, Emerald Forest, Redrock Canyon, Ancient Ruins, Frostpeak Tundra, Jungle Basin, Shadow Grove and Ember Volcano.

⚔️ BATTLE & LEVEL UP – Fight monsters, elites and huge bosses, clear dungeons and reach Level 50.

💎 TREASURE HUNT – Find hidden chests, mana crystals, wisps and shooting stars all over the map!

🌌 DAY & NIGHT – When the aurora lights up the night sky, everyone gets 2x Luck, Gold and XP!

🎩 STYLE – Unlock wizard hats and cloaks that boost your luck.

🐴 RIDE – Earn your own horse companion to gallop across the world.

🏰 Join the town and become an NPC in YOUTOPIA!

❄️ The WINTER UPDATE is coming soon. Hit the 🔔 to get notified!
